integrity: Two self-contained standard-library verification programs check the exhaustive acyclic discrete-Morse matching, signed integral differential, and independent field-chain homology. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact integral homotopy types are established only for the edge graphs of truncated four- and five-simplices. An infinite-dimensional family formula is neither claimed nor tested. Equivalent unindexed literature is a residual novelty risk.
title: The independence complexes of the truncated four- and five-simplices
